scope: Keep desktop dock-to-dock grouping on the physical side of the canvas where the user dropped the target panel, even when the saved dock order reverses panel IDs.

behavior.group_target_side: The actual center of the visible target dock is compared with the canvas center; the grouped panel pair occupies that physical left or right track.
behavior.announcement: The polite live-region message identifies the resulting physical side of the canvas.
behavior.canvas: Existing CSS Grid behavior preserves an uncovered canvas of at least 400 CSS px.
behavior.preference: The user-selected stable three-region dock order is retained while tab grouping is enabled.
behavior.page_data: Dock grouping changes only shell/workspace state; it does not touch Page Model, Save, or Publish.

implementation.reused_project_solution: Existing six-order dock preference, CSS Grid workspace geometry, target-region drag/drop and setPanelGrouping API are reused; the group side is derived from live target/canvas rectangles instead of the target panel identifier.
